primary_regression_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_compact_instructions.py tests/test_cpu_rtl.py tests/test_hardware_assembler.py
reviewed_invariants: Signed 20-bit immediates preserve legacy operation, all register destinations and flag behavior.
The assembler accepts signed values or their matching 32-bit two-complement spelling without truncation.
Unsigned targets do not overlap branch condition bits; jump/call retain all 24 target bits.
Legacy two-word encodings and extension fetch remain unchanged.
Compact calls push the following one-word PC; mixed compact/legacy calls return correctly under stalled fetches.
VALID true and false are established by actual HASHCMP execution in RTL.
scope_limit: High architectural target bits are checked in one-step CPUReference execution; this does not claim physical RAM exists at those targets or prove complete-world operation.
